mapper.insert: insert into meal_order_dishes(meal_order_id, dishes_id, dishes_name, dishes_price, order_num, set_flag, total_amount, really_amount, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{mealOrderId}, #{dishesId}, #{dishesName}, #{dishesPrice}, #{orderNum}, #{setFlag}, #{totalAmount}, #{reallyAmount}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from meal_order_dishes where meal_order_id = #{mealOrderId} order by id
